verified.scientific_identities: Complete typed input, original 128 candidate shape/order/bytes, RNG keys, and frozen 22-file model/normalizer map retained; runtime entry authenticates before and after.
verified.prospective_order: All seven 128-candidate forecasts are durable/readback exact and sealed before first new physical future; fresh teacher evaluation occurs after all actuals and cannot alter sealed forecasts.
verified.resource: Before/after each trial reserve ALL remaining physical baseline intervals, applicable original-D2 source comparisons, full-result persistence groups and fixed/final work. Per-component maxima cannot decrease. 1.5 safety, 7200s cumulative cap, 5GiB incremental cap and 2GiB free reserve remain unchanged.
verified.prefix_preservation: Returned StepResults append before cooperative action-boundary deadline/free-space checks. Error/interruption paths seal returned raw before repeat/source/full-result comparators. SIGINT/TERM enter preservation path; explicit missing rows retained, no retry.
verified.scientific_invalid: Scientific invalidity remains a result; no demand for ready to pass recording fidelity. A keeps nominal H5 cost and passive first-ready semantics; B is supervisor plus longer zero-tail contrast and has no H5 cost.
verified.teacher_masks: All fresh first-repeat A prefix transitions retained with component transition/observation/contact-geometry flags and effective physical-valid mask using same frozen _physical_reasons; no repeated-prefix benchmark labels.

nonblocking_limits: This design review does not establish live entry success or actual execution completion; execution must authenticate these hashes and pass current free-space/whole-future checks.

Observed maxima plus safety are empirical forecasts, not universal runtime guarantees. An unreturned native call, hard kill, power loss or storage hardware failure is outside cooperative prefix assurance.
One selected restored state and finite bank cannot establish population handoff success, full MPC performance or sole cause of original failures.
A/B full-horizon differences combine command supervision, horizon and termination convention; no direct A prediction-error versus B actual error attribution.
The 600s final audit/report reserve is prospective remaining work, not measured elapsed; actual post-run audit time must also be charged before declaring cumulative cap compliance.
